newsitem.title: UK: Brussels Airport - CCS potential still unrealised.
newsitem.headline: Brussels Airport - CCS potential still unrealised.

text.p: Five years after launching the Brussels Airport air cargo community system, the Belgian airport's deputy airport manager, said he still felt "unsatisfied".

"Too many parties involved still do not realise the potential of advantages and economical benefit they can derive from this system of communication and processing," F.Machtelinckx, told an air cargo conference here stressing that the integration between equipment and infrastructure is vital for the air cargo industry.

"With the availability of EDI and vastly improved communication systems and channels, it is absolutely necessary that the air cargo industry makes full use of this modern and fast flow of information and tracing."

Many international airports had already created the so-called cargo community systems linking all parties involved and making the paperless and courierless processing of air cargo 'something which is right around the corner', he added.

Machtelinckx expressed frustration: "When I ask forwarders why they have not taken a decision to link up their EDI with the airport, they reply that too few airlines are linked up." The airlines, he said reply that not enough forwarders are linked up.
None of them doubt the advantages of the system and its use as an indispensable tool for the development of the air cargo trade but feel not enough firms are yet using it.

He said the airport was in a vicious circle and as such had taken some decisions. For instance, he said, messages and data sent by the forwarders to the airlines would also be sent to ground handlers.

Forwarders using the cargo community system will when delivering their shipments for export to the ground handlers be served at gates giving priority treatment, he said, as all data on these shipments will already be in the ground handler's computer.

He stressed that once the IATA bar code system is fully operational, then the use of the Cargo Community System will become even more paramount. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
